en: Multiview color postcard labeled ALBA IULIA, showing landmarks of Alba Iulia, Romania: the Baroque gates of the Alba Carolina Citadel, the Obelisk of Horea, Cloșca și Crișan, the interior of the Union Hall (Sala Unirii), and historic buildings of the citadel. The reverse has Romanian layout 'CARTE POSTALA', a green 40 bani 'POSTA ROMANA' stamp, an Alba Iulia postmark, and handwritten Romanian message addressed to Bucharest.
